name: Dashboard — typed HTTP client for chuck-dashboard.mjs
description: Typed HTTP client for the chuck-dashboard cockpit (9454 LOC long-running HTTP server on localhost:7777, persistent + dynamic status surface for fleet health, principle scores, in-flight processes, recent panels, live event stream). Tool 'dashboard' actions: query (GET any /api path), health (liveness probe), status (LaunchAgent state via launchctl). Read-only — never starts/stops/restarts the daemon. Full TS port deferred to v0.2 (would require 9454 LOC port + replacing the LaunchAgent).

host.label: Dashboard host
host.help: Defaults to 127.0.0.1 (the chuck-dashboard.mjs server only binds loopback).

port.label: Dashboard port
port.help: Defaults to 7777 (matches chuck-dashboard.mjs DEFAULT_PORT). Honor process.env.PORT if you've reconfigured the daemon.
